text: ...and Lieutenant Ashworth, I know what London asked of you. We will discuss it.
...still there? Stubborn. Good. Stubborn is good.
Fasbender. If you are leaving the inn: the salt road, east, nine kilometres. Whatever you hear at Kaltenbrunn... do not let the bell ring.
The Hauptschalter, the main switch, is in the Generator Hall. Nothing in this place happens without power.
The pylons sing only when someone stands beside them. Don't leave them.
My recordings are on the old field sets. Listen for static that doesn't belong.
A bell, a frame, a crank. Rail Yard, Barracks, Chapel. The workbench is by the turbines.
The chapel bell lights for only the forge's work. Strike it with something that has been through the Crucible.
Mahlknecht must die in the chapel, while the bell burns. Lure him there.
Four bells: the yard, the offices, the chapel, the laboratory. Small ones. Brass. Look up.
Play the box again if you forget. The order is all that matters.
When the crate next moves, the drummer will not vanish. Watch it. Shoot it.
Use the bell-weapon near the vault. Thirty of them. The shard wants their last breath.
Yes! Yes, this is better. Gravelight, my name is Emil Fasbender. I am a physicist at the Kaltenbrunn works. I was the one who called London. I am the reason you are here.
In the mine they found a stone. Black glass, veins like a bruise. It hums. The dead near it... remember. Only one thing. Hunger. Reinholt calls it a miracle. I call it a mistake we keep making.

Listen carefully. In the morning the snow will stop and they will stop with it, for a while. Follow the rail line east, nine kilometres. A gatehouse, a headframe tower. I will find you. And Gravelight... bring whoever is still standing. Bring all of them.
—asmacher... the notes... the frequencies...
Glasmacher, repeating. If you have found my technician's notes: three numbers. The lowest first. Lock each one, and wait for me. I am listening on all three.
—asmacher calling Gra—, Glasmacher calling Gravel— ...anyone?
Gravelight, it is round— it is the tenth wave. You are still alive. That is... more than I hoped. More than I deserve to hope.
If the signal is lost, you will still come. You must. I have everything they want. Everything.
Gravelight, a word of warning. The voice on the loudspeakers, the cheerful one. Do not believe a single—
Gravelight, if— hear me, your aircraft— not flak. I am sorry. It was— the hum.
Gravelight, this is Glasmacher. You are at the crossroads. The inn. Do not try the road west, the road west is—
Do you hear them? They are drawn to warmth. To voices. To me, perhaps. I must keep this short.
You must reach Kaltenbrunn. Follow the rail line. Do not let the bell ring.
I have notes. Frequencies. I left them— the innkeeper's family, they were... ...I left them in the house. Find them. Tune the set.
Dr. Reinholt does not know I am transmitting. If she knew— no. Never mind what she would do.
No, no, that was not... they heard that. Everything out there heard that. Start again. The lowest first.
Wrong. Wrong, and loud. I am sorry, I should have... again, from the first number. Quickly, please.
If you are hearing this, the power is on and you are deeper than I wanted you to be. First line of the exchange: %d1% %d2%. Red, for the first. Remember red.
Second pair: %d3% %d4%. Blue. I chose colors so the cheerful one could not make sense of it. It counts numbers; it does not understand them. Not yet.
Last pair: %d5% %d6%. White. The switchboard in Administration. Red, blue, white. Then I can speak to you properly. Live. If I am still alive.

...Gravelight? It's done. I... I am at the rail siding. She took the train. She has a fragment. Of course she does. Of course she— ...I'll meet you at the siding. Bring the samples. I mean, bring yourselves.
You built it! Its note matches the chapel bell, matches the heart. Now, the Overseer, Mahlknecht. He keeps the reliquary key. You will find him where the bell is lit.
That box... that was Liesl's. Augusta brought it here in 'thirty-nine. The tune is different every time it plays. The heart chooses. Ring the four bells in its order.
The heart is listening to you now. Something will try to leave. Something small. Don't let it.
That shard, it's been inside the crate all this time, carried back and forth. Put it in the Crucible. Feed it the dead. It will overload the heart from inside.
This is it! Hold, hold for two minutes! When it breaks, run for the lift! Gravelight, I'm—
...Hello? Gravelight? Oh, thank God. Thank God. You made it to the mine.

I am below you, in a place the Ledger cannot hear, which is very few places. Listen. The heart in the vault, the great crystal. Everything here draws from it. The dead, the tonics, the crates, the voice. If it breaks, it all breaks.
Augusta, Dr. Reinholt, does not want it broken. She wants it louder. She believes her daughter is inside. I don't know that she's wrong. That's what frightens me.
There is a bell, a weapon I designed for clearing collapses. The Totenglocke. The parts are scattered. Build it, and I will tell you what comes next.
That was her. That was Augusta. She is not here, she's speaking from somewhere along the line. Do not answer her.
Glasmacher calling Gravelight. Please, if anyone is alive on that aircraft... please answer.
Do not let the bell ring. When it rings, the dead remember they were hungry.
The Pylons are tuning forks. Three of them. Strike them together and the vault will... sing open. Forgive the poetry. I have been alone a long time.
Did I make the tonics? I... calculated the dilutions. That is not the same thing. It is not the same.
Augusta was my friend. I want you to know that before you hate her. And before you hate me.
You turned on the power. Good. And terrible. She'll be watching now. Both of them will.
